## Technical Requirements

- You will be working on your own laptop computer.
- If you would like to borrow a laptop let me know.
- If you are working on Windows you need to install WSL2 via PowerShell (see Software page)
- For the bootcamp (Week 0): latest version of R ([install here](https://www.r-project.org)), Python 3 ([install here](https://www.python.org/downloads/); on Windows check "Add python.exe to PATH"), and Positron ([install here](https://positron.posit.co/download)), the IDE used in class, which bundles Quarto.
- Optional alternative IDEs: VS Code ([install here](https://code.visualstudio.com/download)) and RStudio ([install here](https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/)).
- Later in the course (Week 9): a LaTeX distribution for PDF output - TinyTeX via `quarto install tinytex` ([details here](https://quarto.org/docs/output-formats/pdf-engine.html)), or a full distribution such as [MacTeX](https://www.tug.org/mactex/) or [MiKTeX](https://miktex.org/download).
- Later in the course (Weeks 9-10): Git ([install here](https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/Getting-Started-Installing-Git)) and a GitHub account ([sign up here](https://github.com/signup)) using your UO email.
- A terminal that allows ssh connection to the UO computing cluster (Talapas).
